reason: The plugin enables a text-only primary model to handle image attachments by representing them as placeholders and delegating image reading to a session-scoped visual subagent.

summaries.zh: 该插件将图片附件转换为带附件标识符的文本占位符，并委托会话中的视觉子代理读取图片内容。
summaries.en: This plugin lets a text-only primary model handle image attachments by representing them as identifiers in text placeholders and delegating image reading to a visual subagent in the session.

capabilities: Projects image attachments into text placeholders containing attachment identifiers
Delegates image reading to a visual subagent through read_attachment or read_image
Routes image-related requests within the current session
